failures.component: Verified ZIP Finder / ChromeOS Archive Safety
failures.root_cause: The test created a test directory using default umask (0o775), violating the strict _require_private_directory() assertion (which asserts not (st_mode & 0o022)).
failures.repair: Explicitly enforce mode=0o700 during directory.mkdir() in the test fixture.
failures.acceptance_criteria: All 16 zip finder tests pass without altering strict security assertion in production tool.

failures.component: Bun Frontend Test Runtime / Missing Node Modules
failures.symptom: 7 Bun test errors: 'Cannot find package zod', 'Cannot find package react' when running fresh bun test.
failures.root_cause: Node modules were not installed in the website workspace in the pristine sandbox environment.
failures.reproduction: Run bun test in website directory without prior bun install.
failures.repair: Run bun install in website directory.
failures.acceptance_criteria: 173 bun tests across 25 files pass cleanly, 0 failures.

failures.symptom: Over 145 remote branches diverged from canonical main with unmerged features, duplicated fixes, and conflicting handoff logs across Jules, Cursor, and Copilot.
failures.root_cause: Absence of a single authoritative gatekeeper and concurrent agent execution creating independent PRs and candidate branches without serialized promotion.
failures.repair: Transition away from Jules to ChatGPT Work as lead investigator and architect, enforce strict PR convergence policy, freeze merge authority on HOLD pending owner sign-off.
failures.acceptance_criteria: Establish single canonical branch/PR matrix (CCCLVI_BRANCH_PR_MATRIX.csv) and execution roadmap.

failures.symptom: Staging private Qwen connectivity can fail closed if model identity does not match or if network is unconfigured; paid remote inference must never be triggered.
failures.root_cause: Commit fc2bed4 correctly locked down unverified fallback, but live inference requires local hardware serving Qwen 2.5 7B/14B with verified identity headers.
failures.reproduction: Call verify_xaeli_private_qwen.py without local server running.
failures.repair: Enforce fail-closed state where website /xaeli displays UNCONFIGURED / NOT_CONNECTED rather than simulating live answers.
failures.acceptance_criteria: Website returns proper unconfigured diagnostics and refuses synthetic promotion to live.

failures.symptom: 1 pytest test skipped (training/tests/test_lora_smoke.py) due to torch not being present in standard lightweight test environment.
failures.root_cause: PyTorch is an optional heavy dependency excluded from minimal pyproject.toml dev profile to prevent massive container bloat.
failures.reproduction: python3 -m pytest training/tests/test_lora_smoke.py without torch installed.
failures.repair: Branch work/kusanagi-cccxiv-forge-ci-optional-torch isolates optional torch checks. Model Forge design ensures fail-closed fallback without torch.
failures.acceptance_criteria: Test gracefully skips with informative warning when torch is absent; passes when torch is available.

failures.symptom: Historical risk of unverified exposure being reported as recovered cash.
failures.root_cause: Ambiguity in initial commercial designs between identified leakage and collected funds.
failures.repair: Golden oracle locks confirmed_recovery strictly to 0.00 in all automated runs. Only human owner key can confirm recovery.
failures.acceptance_criteria: Golden oracle tests strictly enforce exposure categories: identified $385.00, confirmed $0.00.
